    def _pool_field(self, selected, name):
        token_ids = getattr(self, f"{name}_ids")[selected]
        mask = getattr(self, f"{name}_mask")[selected]
        # Called inside forward's disabled-autocast context. Sum directly into
        # field vectors without materializing a rows x tokens x dimension tensor.
        # Functional embedding_bag preserves gradients to the shared token table.
        offsets = torch.arange(
            0, token_ids.numel(), token_ids.size(1), device=token_ids.device
        )
        pooled = F.embedding_bag(
            token_ids.reshape(-1),
            self.tokens.weight.float(),
            offsets,
            mode="sum",
            padding_idx=0,
            include_last_offset=False,
        )
        counts = mask.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True).clamp_min(1).float()
        return pooled / counts
